additions.reason: The Rebbe explicitly calls the yetzer tov a bechina of 'לֵב חָכָם לִימִינוֹ' (Kohelet 10:2) and also a bechina of 'לֵב בָּשָׂר' (Yechezkel 36:26). The good inclination is the heart that is drawn rightward — the same inner rightness that produces holy prayer. It belongs with the Prayer package because the 'right hand' (yamino) raises fallen loves and fears to holy ones, and the good inclination is described as the agent that cancels sadness and scoffing (the obstacles to prayer). The yetzer tov is not in the dataset as a bechina-node for this Torah.

additions.reason: The Rebbe describes the chametz (leaven) in a person's heart as 'הוּא הַמֵּסִית אֶת הָאָדָם שֶׁיְּהַרְהֵר אַחַר תַּלְמִידֵי חֲכָמִים' — it is the evil inclination/seduction that turns the heart against the sages of the generation. The chametz/leaven is the evil yetzer of the heart (יֵצֶר לֵב הָאָדָם רַע) — the evil counterpart to the yetzer tov (Package 1). It belongs in the evil package as the inner adversary parallel to the external evil waters.

The Torah text (lines 1-17) contains rich eitza connections not captured as bechina edges, particularly: tikkun habrit → prayer → kedushah shabbat → holy body → mamon/mazal → yetzer tov → light of eyes → geulah → atonement cycle.
The missing nodes (יצר טוב, לב חכם לימינו, לב בשר, פסח, ימין, שאור וחמץ) each have explicit bechina language in the source text and should be considered for addition to the dataset.
Node 'שהשכינה מכסה דמהון של ישראל, שנשפך באהבה הזאת' is a long descriptive phrase rather than a compact concept label — it may benefit from normalization to 'כסוי דם בשכינה' or similar.

The good/evil mirror structure: Package 1 (Prayer/Right hand) mirrors Package 5 evil (External waters/chametz); Package 4 (Shame/Atonement) partially mirrors the evil of Package 5 (the external forces that try to suck the shed blood). Package 2 (Shabbat/Knowledge) and Package 3 (Holy Body) do not have explicit evil mirrors in the bechina dataset, though the source text contrasts the holy body (Package 3) with 'גוּפוֹ הַמְצֹרָע מִמָּשְׁכָא דְחִוְיָא' (the leprous body from snake-skin), which is an implicit evil counterpart.
